rows.note: Use this as the common general choice when a service or system has moved from paper to electronic handling.

example.english: The bank’s account-opening process is now paperless, so we no longer need to fill in so many forms.
example.traditional: 銀行開戶程序而家已經電子化，唔使再填咁多表格喇。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 hoi1 wu6 cing4 zeoi6 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 din6 zi2 faa3 m4 sai2 zoi3 tin4 gam3 do1 biu2 gaak3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when you specifically want to stress that paper is no longer used, especially in formal descriptions or compounds such as 無紙化賬單.

example.english: The company will introduce paperless bills next month, and customers will receive them by email.
example.traditional: 公司下個月推行無紙化賬單，客戶會用電郵收單。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 teoi1 hang4 mou4 zi2 faa3 zoeng3 daan1 haak3 wu6 wui5 jung6 din6 jau4 sau1 daan1

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when explaining directly that a process or document does not require paper.

example.english: This application process is paperless; you can complete everything online.
example.traditional: 呢個申請程序唔使用紙，全部喺網上完成就得喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 cing2 cing4 zeoi6 m4 sai2 jung6 zi2 cyun4 bou6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 jyun4 sing4 zau6 dak1 laa3
